name: MK Cards
subtitle: Digital business cards & NFC
promotionalText: Share your card with a QR code, link, NFC tag or Apple Wallet, and scan the cards of people you meet.
description:
MK Cards is your business card, always with you.

Create elegant digital cards for work, clients or events, in English and Arabic. Share them with a QR code, a link, an NFC tag or Apple Wallet. The person you meet needs no app: one tap saves your contact.

SHARE ANYWHERE
• Full-screen QR code, ready to scan
• Add your card to Apple Wallet
• Write your card to NFC stickers and cards
• Share your link in any app

NEVER LOSE A CONTACT
• Scan paper business cards: the details are read for you
• Scan event badges with a QR code
• Visitors can send you their details from your card page
• Save contacts to your iPhone, export them, or send them to Salesforce

LOOK PROFESSIONAL
• Formal card designs with your photo and company logo
• Email signatures with your QR code
• Video-call backgrounds for Zoom, Teams and Meet

KNOW WHAT WORKS
• See how often each card is viewed and saved

FOR COMPANIES
• Matching cards for the whole team, imported from a spreadsheet
• Sign in with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
• Switch cards off and show a message when someone leaves
• Company Salesforce connection and activity exports
reviewNotes:
MK Cards creates digital business cards. Sign in with the demo account below (Log in with username).

Native features to try:
• Share tab: full-size QR code, Add to Apple Wallet, Write to an NFC tag (needs an NFC sticker).
• Scan tab: Business card opens the VisionKit document camera and reads the card on the device; Event badge opens the live QR scanner. Any printed business card works.
• Contacts tab: save a contact to the iPhone address book.
• Sign in with Apple on the welcome screen.

Microsoft and Google sign-in are for company accounts and are optional. Salesforce needs the customer's own Salesforce account. The app sells nothing; company plans are arranged outside the app.
